purpose: Enforce the monotonic local-account security revision invariant in PostgreSQL.
lockImpact: Takes a bounded lock while PostgreSQL validates the nonnegative security_revision constraint.
dataImpact: No valid account row changes; the migration fails closed if an invalid negative revision exists.
backfill: Not required after the approved empty local-development reset.
recovery: Retain the constraint during application rollback because all prior valid revisions satisfy it.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed workforce-access-owned migration. Do not rewrite this migration after application.
